Commentary.Commentary: That's it from this game. A huge game is coming up. Namibia will take on UAE in the final game of Group A. Still, all to play for in that game. If Namibia win, they go through but if UAE win, Netherlands will edge past. So, switch the tabs and do join us for that game. Till then, cheers!

Dasun Shanaka, the captain of Sri Lanka says they were confident to go through but the first game against Namibia didn't go well but the players did well to win this game, especially the bowlers. Reckons the pitch was two-paced and again credits the bowlers.

Scott Edwards, the skipper of Netherlands says they bowled well earlier but the game slipped in middle and the back end. Hopes that UAE can win the game and they can go through. He is disappointed that the qualifications are not in their hands.

Kusal Mendis is the Player of the match. He says earlier the wicket was slow so he tried to bat for a long time and take on the loose ball. Adds Charith Asalanka played really well as he took the pressure of him.
...Presentation coming up...

Netherlands were really good with the ball for the first half but gave the bulk of the runs in the last 10. The results could have been different if they bowled a little bit better. In reply with the bat, no one other than Max O'Dowd had the impetus. He batted throughout the innings but kept losing his partners at the other end. Netherlands were just one good partnership away to give a tough battle but it wasn't meant to be. Now, surely the Netherlands players will glue to the screen and cheer for UAE to win their game.

A hard loss against Namibia was followed by a big win against UAE. Sri Lanka needed to win this game to go through and they have done it the hard way. It was Kusal Mendis' innings that helped Sri Lanka post a competitive total. The momentum was with them and the bowlers started brilliantly as well. They kept taking wickets at regular intervals. The pitch was sluggish and the spinners made the most of it. Wanindu Hasaranga and Maheesh Theekshana combined to take five wickets. The latter did give away 16 runs in the penultimate over which kept Netherlands hope alive but Lahiru Kumara kept his cool and took his team through.

SRI LANKA ARE THROUGH TO THE NEXT ROUND. It looked like Sri Lanka had an easy job in their hand but Max O'Dowd till the last breath kept the hopes alive. It was just too many for him to single-handedly chase it down.
A length ball, outside off, Max O'Dowd looks to pull but misses. SRI LANKA WIN BY 16 RUNS.
On a length and outside off. Max O'Dowd slashes and misses.
FOUR! Full and outside off. Max O'Dowd looks to go downtown but slices it over backward point for a boundary.

Bye! A quick single! Short and on off. Roelof van der Merwe looks to pull but misses. The keeper has a shy at his end but misses. Roelof van der Merwe was nowhere to the other end but Lahiru Kumara fumbled to collect the ball cleanly and misses his shy at his end.

This is full and on middle, Max O'Dowd whacks it to deep square leg. m was always coming for the second but the second run was not available. Roelof van der Merwe has to get back in his crease and the replay shows his bat was inside the line before the keeper removes the bails.
Effort ball! On a length and outside off. Max O'Dowd swings hard and misses.
Lahiru Kumara to bowl the last one.
Max O'Dowd does get a single! He will keep the strike. This is full and outside off, it's driven to sweeper cover for one. 23 runs needed from the last over. 16 runs come off this one.
Very full and outside off. Max O'Dowd knocks it to cover. Max O'Dowd will look for a single now.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
SIX! 24 runs needed in 10 balls! Max O'Dowd is playing a gem of an innings! Tossed up, outside off. Max O'Dowd slog-sweeps it all the way over deep mid-wicket. The fielder jumps but in vain.
A carrom ball, full and outside off. Max O'Dowd swings across and misses.
In the air and taken! Flatter and outside off. Max O'Dowd launches it high and to deep mid-wicket where the catch is taken. The batters do not take any run. Roelof van der Merwe is struggling to run.
Wide! This is again outside off. Wided. Maheesh Theekshana is feeling the pressure.
Wide! This is way outside off. Max O'Dowd leaves it alone. Free hit cotinues.

NO BALL AND A SIX! Not a good start by Maheesh Theekshana! A high full toss on middle. Max O'Dowd pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. It was above the chest and a no ball is given. Free-hit coming up.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for one.

Pitched up, around middle and off. Max O'Dowd goes back and looks to whip but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW and the finger stays down. Sri Lanka take the review. No bat there. Ball Tracking shows the ball goes across the angle and goes onto miss the off pole.

OUT! RUN OUT! Sri Lanka are getting closer. A full toss on leg. Max O'Dowd mistimes his push straight to cover. Paul van Meekeren was running across but there was never a run. He is sent back. Dasun Shanaka comes up with the golden arm, he throws it on the non-striker's end and finds Paul van Meekeren well short.
FOUR MORE! 14 runs now! 50 for O'Dowd! He is single-handedly keeping Netherlands in the game! Poor bowling this! Full and on the pads, this is clipped through square leg for four runs.
FOUR! 10 off first two now! Too full and on leg. O'Dowd flicks it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
SIX! Max O'Dowd is still out there from the start! He is keeping the hopes alive! Floated on middle. Max O'Dowd hammers it over mid-wicket for a biggie.

OUT! TIMBER! Wanindu Hasaranga gets his third wicket. Fred Klaassen comes down the track as he looks to heave it. Wanindu Hasaranga serves it full. slow and on middle, the ball stays really low and goes past Fred's bat to dislodge the stumps.
Around off, pushed through covers for a couple of runs.
Full and on middle. Max O'Dowd reverse sweeps it to point for a single.
On middle. Max O'Dowd paddles it to point. Fred Klaassen was a quick single but is sent back. A direct hit at the bowler's end but Fred Klaassen was well in.
Flighted ball on middle. Fred Klaassen flicks it to square leg for a single.
Fred Klaassen comes in.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Two in two for the Lankans! What a bowling performance this is! A googly from the magician, flatter, slower in the air and on middle. Timm van der Gugten lunges forward to work on the leg side but misses and the ball hits the leg pole. Wanindu Hasaranga gets his second.

OUT! RUN OUT! A DIRECT HIT AND PRINGLE GOES NOW! Max O'Dowd is running out of partners. This is on middle. O'Dowd bunts it to wide of long on and calls for a couple. Tim Pringle was running on the dangerous side. Dhananjaya de Silva runs across, collects and hits the stumps at the bowler's end. The replay shows Tim Pringle was not even in the frame.
Outside off, punched through point for a single.
Tim Pringle has no clue how to play this one! A carrom ball, short and around off. Tim Pringle plays the wrong line and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Very full and on off, drives to covers for a single.
Tossed up, around off. O'Dowd pushes it to cover.
A full toss on middle. O'Dowd drives it to cover.
A length ball, outside off. Tim Pringle looks to go big but misses.
Good variations from Binura! A slower ball on the pads. O'Dowd works it to point for one.
Around off, dabbed to third man for a single.

OUT! BOWLED! Another timely wicket from Sri Lanka! They are doing well to break the stand regularly. Binura Fernando strikes this time. One shot too many from the skipper! A knuckle ball, full and slanting at the base of the leg pole. Scott Edwards gets inside the line to sweep but misses and the ball hits the stumps. Just when Netherlands were running away, Sri Lanka strike.
A slower short ball on middle. Scott Edwards looks to fend it away but mistimes it back on the deck.
FOUR! Uses the pace! 100 up! The skipper is looking in good touch now! On a length and on leg. Scott Edwards steps across and paddles it past fine leg for four.

A SINGLE! Tossed up on middle. Scott Edwards sweeps it to deep square leg for one. First over by Netherlands which goes for a double-digit. 14 runs off it. A couple of more like this and they will be very happy.
Wanindu Hasaranga gives a bit more flight, this is around off. Scott Edwards paddles it over short fine leg for a couple more.
On middle, swept again to deep square leg for a couple. Two runs. Good running. 10 already off the over.
FOUR! Two in a row! Scott Edwards with two now! Full ball, outside off. Scott Edwards again sweeps it firmly through square leg for four.
FOUR! Much needed! A googly, full and outside off. Scott Edwards gets inside the line and sweeps behind square leg for a boundary.
Wanindu Hasaranga bowls with a slingy action, almost like Malinga! Full and outside off, pushed through covers for one.

On a length and on middle. Scott Edwards plays it late but straight to point. Another good over from Sri Lanka. Just five runs from it. Netherlands need to change the gears now. They need 81 runs in 42 balls.
On middle. Scott Edwards keeps it out.
Length ball, outside off, cut past point for a couple.
Outside off, guided straight to point.
Wide! This is full and down the leg side. Left alone.
Full and on middle. O'Dowd drills it to long on for one more.
A single as Scott Edwards works it to square leg.
On middle, swept to deep square leg for a single.
THREE RUNS! Good running! On the pads. O'Dowd helps it to short fine leg where the fielder dives over the ball and lets it through for three runs.
Leg bye! Full and outside off. Scott Edwards looks to sweep but misses. An appeal for LBW but that was clearly way outside the line.
Scott Edwards walks out to the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! A stand was building but Maheesh Theekshana gets the breakthrough. Excellent bowling. The required rate was rising and Tom Cooper has to go for something innovative but fails to connect. A flicker, this is full and around off. Tom Cooper plays the wrong line as he looks to sweep. He misses and the stumps are disturbed.
This is full and outside off, it's driven to deep cover for one more.
A quicker, flatter ball on leg. O'Dowd works it to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is hit to deep square leg for one. 8 runs off the over.
FOUR! Class! Lahiru Kumara tries the slower ball but instead gives too much width. O'Dowd waits and slaps it over covers for a boundary.
Outside off. Cooper cuts this time but gets a thick outside edge to third man for a single.
On a length and outside off. Coper tries to play the late cut shot but misses.
Very full and outside off. Tom fails to squeeze it away.
Length ball, outside off. Cooper looks to rive but slices it over covers for a couple of runs.

Drinks! Sri Lanka are on top right now but Netherlands have started the repair work already. These two look in good touch and will look to take the game deep now. Still, a long way to go and it's anyone's game from here. Netherlands need another 100 runs from 60 balls.
On middle, eased to long on for a single.
On a length and on middle. Cooper fends it on the leg side. Three dots on the trot.
Well bowled! Lack of pace from Shanaka, outside off. Cooper looks to cut but misses.
Full and outside off, driven to cover.
Fuller ball, outside off. Cooper drives on the up and to deep cover for a brace.
FOUR! Pitched up, outside off. Cooper uses his feet and lofts it over mid off, it goes off the toe end of the bat but enough to clear the fielder. A boundary.
Tosses it up, full and just outside off. O'Dowd looks to reverse paddle it but misses. A muted appeal follows for LBW but nothing given.
Touch short and on middle. O'Dowd pulls it behind square leg. The fielder dives to his left and makes a sliding stop. Two runs.
Outside off, kept out.
Slower ball, fuller and on off. O'Dowd keeps it out. Too many dot balls from Netherlands.
Tossed up, outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Half-volley, outside off. O'Dowd looks to cut but misses.
FOUR! A welcome boundary! This is full  and around off. Cooper lofts it over mid on for four.
Short in length and outside off. O'Dowd pulls it to long on for one.
Outside off, steered to third man for a single.
This is full and wide of off. Cooper fails to drive it away.
Short in length, outside off, extra bounce. Tom dabs it to backward point.
Very full and around off. Tom Cooper pushes it to mid off.
Around off. Tom works it to square leg for a single.
A googly, full and around leg. Tom Cooper leans to defend but misses and the ball goes past inside edge and hits on the pads. It was going down.
Tossed up on off. Tom Cooper tucks it to mid-wicket.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! An easy return catch for Wanindu Hasaranga and another one goes now! Netherlands are losing their grip on the chase! This is the wrong 'un, full and around off. Colin Ackermann prods and chips it straight back to Wanindu Hasaranga who takes an easy catch. Golden duck for Colin Ackermann.
THREE MORE! Quicker, flatter, outside off. O'Dowd dabs it past first slip towards third man for three more runs.
FOUR! Wanindu Hasaranga starts with a short ball, around off, this is pulled to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Wanindu Hasaranga is into the attack. Colin Ackermann is the new man in.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Right at the end of the Powerplay, Sri Lanka have a wicket and a big one of De Leede! Back of a length and outside off. Bas de Leede opens the face of the bat and tries to run it down to third man but only manages an outside edge and it goes to the keeper. An appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Bas de Leede knew he edged one there and starts walking away. What an over from Lahiru Kumara. Netherlands are 40/2. 123 runs needed in 84 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Kusal Mendis b Lahiru Kumara

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and around off. Bas de Leede defends it out.
SIX! BANG! Well played! Short ball, outside off. Bas de Leede steps across and pulls it high over square leg for a biggie.
Outside off, again guided straight to backward point.
Outside off on a length. Bas de Leede chops it to backward point. Two dots to start the over.
On a length and outside off. Bas de Leede defended out.
THREE RUNS! Binura Fernando serves it down the leg side. Bas de Leede tickles it past short fine leg for three runs.
Around off, knocked to cover.
Should be hit better! A full toss on middle. O'Dowd swings across but mistimes and the ball lobs past the fielder at mid on for a single.
On a length and outside off. O'Dowd punches but finds cover.
Short of a length and outside off. Bas de Leede taps it through third man for a single.
On the pads, clipped to square leg for a single.
Wide! Down the leg side. O'Dowd fails to flick it.
FOUR! Off the mark! Very full and outside off. Bas de Leede leans and drives it through covers for four runs.
Bas de Leede is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! That was coming! Vikramjit Singh was not able to connect the ball at all. This is full and on middle, angling in. Singh gets on his knee to slog it over mid on but fails to make the required connection and ends up spooning it to Dasun Shanaka at mid on. Sri Lanka off to a good start.
Commentary.Howout: c Dasun Shanaka b Maheesh Theekshana

Commentary.Commentary: How has that missed the leg stumps? An arm ball, flat and it comes with an angle, around leg. Singh makes room to slap but misses. The ball rolls just past the pole.
Very full and outside off, swept to short fine leg for a single. Good fielding there as the player dives to his left.
A single as this is hit to long off.
Flatter ball, outside off. Singh punches off the back foot through covers for a brace.
Beautiful shot! This is full and around off. O'Dowd drives it straight past mid off for a boundary. Still a decent over from Binura Fernando.
A SINGLE! Length and on middle. Singh blocks it. The ball rolls past the non-striker's end and the batters crosses.
Short in length and outside off. Singh tries to defend on the up but splices it to point where the fielder dives forward and collects just in front of him.
Another swing and a miss! Vikramjit Singh is struggling with the timing! Length and outside off. Singh looks to slap but misses.
Singh takes the charge, this is full and outside off. Singh swings an misses.
A length ball, outside off. Singh guides it to point.
Binura Fernando to bowl now.
Length ball, outside off and nips back in. O'Dowd pushes it to point.
Around leg. Singh pulls it flat and to fine leg who collects on a bounce. One.
Touch short and outside off. Singh slashes and misses. Better from Lahiru.
That is a lovely delivery! Short in length and on middle, Singh backs away to push but the ball nips away and beats the outside edge.
Outside off, guided to third man for a single.
FIVE WIDES! Extra runs! Kumara serves it short and down the leg side. O'Dowd fails to clip. The extra bounce carries it over the leaping keeper for a boundary.
A full toss, outside off, pushed through covers for a couple.
Lahiru Kumara to bowl from the other end.
This is way outside off, O'Dowd steps across and sweeps it to square leg and will keep the strike.
This one skids on, full and on middle. O'Dowd makes room and knocks it to point.
One more! Floated, full and outside off, driven to long off for one.
Flatter ball on middle. O'Dowd tucks it to square leg for one more.
This is full and wide of off. Singh drives it to long off for a single. Vikramjit Singh is underway as well.
Tossed up on off. O'Dowd flicks it to deep square leg for a single. Netherlands are underway.
